description: BUG 1 — price mis-attribution on long/multi-script chained complaints. Fix the two root causes in awaaz_backend/ai_pipeline.py: (1) _segment_clauses does not split on the Pashto connective ` او `, Punjabi Shahmukhi ` تے `, or Sindhi ` ۽ `, so adjacent item-price pairs collapse into one clause (confirmed live: 'ٹماٹر 250 ... او چینی 180 ...' stays one clause and چینی borrows 250). (2) When a single clause still holds 2+ commodities, each reads extract_price_and_normalize over the WHOLE clause and takes the first price, so the second commodity steals the first's price. Add the missing segmentation delimiters (PRIMARY fix) and a positional nearest-price attribution helper used only when a clause resolves to 2+ commodities (SECONDARY hardening). Keep the existing single-item own-clause/borrow-next/` bhi ` behavior and the LLM _attribute_clause mapping intact. Independent of FEAT-002 at the code level, but FEAT-002's end-to-end Pashto/Punjabi examples depend on this; implement this first.
steps: In ai_pipeline._segment_clauses, extend the re.split alternation to also split on ` او ` (Pashto and, chars U+0627 U+0648), ` تے ` (Punjabi Shahmukhi and, U+062A U+06D2), and ` ۽ ` (Sindhi and, U+06FD). Keep EVERY existing delimiter (`. ۔ ! ? \n bhi بھی aur اور and tay o ، ,`) and the existing strip/empty-drop. The tokens are space-padded so ` او ` cannot overlap the already-present ` اور `. Update the docstring to list the three added connectives.

Add a helper _attribute_prices_positionally(clause, found_items) to ai_pipeline.py: found_items is the ordered [(canonical_id, item_info), ...] from rate_service.find_all_items(clause). For each commodity, find its alias match START position in the clause using the SAME word-boundary pattern rate_service.find_all_items uses ((?<!\w)alias(?!\w)); try the item's resolvable aliases/name and take the earliest match. Find price-number positions by running normalize_digits then parse_word_numbers on the clause and locating plausible PKR numbers (reuse the 10<=n<=10000 and exclude-years rule from nlp_rules.extract_price_and_normalize). Assign each commodity the nearest price token that FOLLOWS its position; if none follows, the nearest price BEFORE it. Build and return a per-commodity sub-clause string (commodity text window up to just past its assigned price number) so the caller can pass each commodity a sub-clause that extract_price_and_normalize re-parses for unit idioms. Return an ordered mapping canonical_id -> sub-clause (and expose the raw price too).

In ai_pipeline._discover_items_by_rules, when len(found) >= 2 for a clause, call _attribute_prices_positionally and pass each commodity its OWN nearest-price sub-clause as the `clause` argument to _reconcile_item (instead of the whole merged clause). Preserve the existing len(found)==1 path exactly: _price_clause_for (own-clause price, else borrow next clause when next has a price and names no other commodity — the ` bhi ` pyaaz=200 trailing case). Preserve the de-dupe-by-seen-id behavior.
Confirm _attribute_clause (LLM item path) still returns the clause that NAMES each LLM item after the finer segmentation; adjust only if a test shows it mis-maps. Expect no logic change.

Add BUG-1 regression tests to awaaz_backend/tests/test_multi_item.py (LLM stubbed via patch.object(ai_pipeline, '_call_ollama_llm_multi', return_value=None) for determinism): (a) test_pashto_digit_chain_each_item_own_price — input 'جنابه، دوکاندار الو 150 روپۍ کيلو، پياز 200 روپۍ کيلو، ٹماٹر 250 روپۍ کيلو او چینی 180 روپۍ کيلو خرڅوي' asserts چینی/chini reported_price == 180 and tamatar == 250 (i.e. no steal) AND detected_language == 'Pashto'. (This test's full 4-item resolution also depends on FEAT-002 aliases; here assert at minimum that chini==180 and tamatar==250 given the ` او ` split; the 4-id assertion is added/strengthened in FEAT-002.) (b) test_two_items_one_clause_positional — a synthetic single clause with two in-vocab commodities and two prices (e.g. 'tamatar 250 aur chini 180' forced into one clause, or call _attribute_prices_positionally directly) asserts each gets its nearest-following price. Keep the existing English 4-item sugar=180 and aaloo+pyaaz pyaaz=200 tests unchanged and passing.
acceptance_criteria: `.\venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "from ai_pipeline import ai_pipeline; print(ai_pipeline._segment_clauses('ٹماٹر 250 روپۍ کيلو او چینی 180 روپۍ کيلو'))"` returns tomato and sugar in SEPARATE list elements.
Running the existing test_multi_item.py tests (English 4-item sugar=180, aaloo+pyaaz pyaaz=200, 7-item exactly-7 no-Chicken, under-rate kept) still passes.
New test test_pashto_digit_chain_each_item_own_price asserts chini==180 and tamatar==250 (no price steal) and passes.
The positional helper never widens commodity matching beyond the existing word-boundary discipline (7-item no-Chicken test unaffected).
verification: From awaaz_backend: `$env:DATABASE_URL=$null; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_multi_item.py tests/test_pipeline.py -q` — all pass.

Segmentation probe: `$env:DATABASE_URL=$null; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "from ai_pipeline import ai_pipeline; print(ai_pipeline._segment_clauses('ٹماٹر 250 روپۍ کيلو او چینی 180 روپۍ کيلو'))"` shows two separate clauses.
findings: IMPLEMENTED in awaaz_backend/ai_pipeline.py. (1) _segment_clauses: added ` او ` (Pashto, U+0627 U+0648), ` تے ` (Punjabi Shahmukhi, U+062A U+06D2), ` ۽ ` (Sindhi, U+06FD) to the re.split alternation (appended as a second raw-string segment); all existing delimiters and strip/empty-drop preserved; docstring updated. Probe confirms 'ٹماٹر 250 روپۍ کيلو او چینی 180 روپۍ کيلو' -> ['ٹماٹر 250 روپۍ کيلو', 'چینی 180 روپۍ کيلو']. (2) Added positional attribution. Exact signatures FEAT-002 / integration can rely on: `AIPipeline._attribute_prices_positionally(self, clause: str, found_items: List[Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any]]]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]` returns an ORDERED mapping canonical_id -> {'sub_clause': str, 'price': Optional[float]}; a commodity with no attributable price gets {'sub_clause': <whole clause>, 'price': None} (never regresses below the old whole-clause read). Two static helpers back it: `AIPipeline._alias_candidates(item_info) -> List[str]` (name_en, name_ur, aliases; lowercased, len>=3, de-duped, longest-first) and `AIPipeline._earliest_alias_pos(clause_lower: str, aliases: List[str]) -> Optional[int]` (uses the SAME (?<!\w)alias(?!\w) pattern as rate_service.find_all_items — matching discipline is NOT widened, 7-item no-Chicken test unaffected). Positions and price tokens are both measured on parse_word_numbers(normalize_digits(clause)) so they are comparable; price tokens use the extract_price_and_normalize fallback rule (10<=n<=10000, exclude 2024/2025/2026). Nearest-FOLLOWING price wins (unused), else nearest preceding unused; each price token is consumed once. (3) _discover_items_by_rules: for len(found) >= 2 it now calls _attribute_prices_positionally once per clause and passes each commodity its own sub_clause as the `clause` arg to _reconcile_item; the len(found)==1 path (_price_clause_for own/borrow-next ` bhi `) and de-dupe-by-seen-id are byte-for-byte unchanged. (4) _attribute_clause (LLM path) needed NO change — the finer segmentation only produces smaller clauses that still NAME each LLM item, so it still maps correctly (no test regressed). CLAUSE-EDGE NOTES for FEAT-002: چینی (chini) and ٹماٹر (tamatar) already resolve via their existing Urdu-script aliases, so the Pashto chain test asserts chini==180 & tamatar==250 WITHOUT FEAT-002; الو/پياز in that same Pashto input still do NOT resolve (rate-list lacks those spellings + the پياز U+064A vs پیاز U+06CC code-point mismatch) — those 4-id assertions are FEAT-002's to add. Did NOT touch auth/CORS/admin-key, DB schema, routers/complaints.py under-rate filtering, or the lazy whisper imports. Tests: added test_pashto_digit_chain_each_item_own_price (asserts chini==180, tamatar==250, detected_language=='Pashto', LLM stubbed) and test_two_items_one_clause_positional (calls _attribute_prices_positionally directly on 'tamatar 250 chini 180', asserts 250/180) to tests/test_multi_item.py; existing English 4-item sugar=180 and aaloo+pyaaz pyaaz=200 tests unchanged. VERIFICATION: `$env:DATABASE_URL=$null; pytest tests/test_multi_item.py tests/test_pipeline.py -q` -> 25 passed; full `pytest tests/ -q` -> 60 passed (Ollama live at :11434).
